_published_faq.name: How do I add HubSpot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HubSpot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.hubspot.com/anthropic. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is HubSpot MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, HubSpot scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the HubSpot MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: HubSpot lists 22 MCP tools, including search_crm_objects, get_user_details, get_properties, search_properties, get_crm_objects, render_landing_page_ui, show_feedback_form, Get campaign analytics, Get campaign asset metrics, Get campaign contacts by type, get_content_analytics, and get_organization_details.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to HubSpot?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to HubSpot in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
HubSpot requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is HubSpot failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: HubSpot scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is Authenticated MCP access is available. Reconnect the server account or provide a valid refreshable OAuth session, then rerun the audit. Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
